def test_migrate_applies_every_file_once_and_in_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    database = Database(tmp_path / "ledger.db")
    expected = sorted(p.stem for p in DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR.glob("*.sql"))
    assert expected[0] == "0001_init"
    assert database.migrate() == expected
    assert database.migrate() == []
    database.close()
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        Database(migrations_dir=tmp_path / "nope").migrate()


def test_customer_round_trip_and_unique_email(db: Database, now: datetime) -> None:
    created = db.add_customer("Ada Example", "ada@example.com", now)
    assert created.id is not None
    assert db.get_customer(created.id) == created
    assert db.find_customer_by_email("ada@example.com") == created
    assert db.find_customer_by_email("nobody@example.com") is None

class Database:
    """A single SQLite connection with schema migrations applied on demand."""

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path = ":memory:", migrations_dir: Path | None = None) -> None:
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        self._migrations_dir = migrations_dir or DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR
        self._depth = 0

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()

    @contextmanager
    def transaction(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        """Commit on success and roll back on error; nested uses join the outer transaction."""
        self._depth += 1
        try:
            yield self._conn
        except BaseException:
            if self._depth == 1:
                self._conn.rollback()
            raise
        else:
            if self._depth == 1:
                self._conn.commit()
        finally:
            self._depth -= 1

    # -- migrations ---------------------------------------------------------

    def migrate(self) -> list[str]:
        """Apply pending ``NNNN_name.sql`` files in order and return their versions."""
        if not self._migrations_dir.is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"migrations directory not found: {self._migrations_dir}")
        self._conn.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations ("
            "version TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)"
        )
        rows = self._conn.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
        done = {row["version"] for row in rows}
        applied: list[str] = []
        for path in sorted(self._migrations_dir.glob("[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.sql")):
            if path.stem in done:
                continue
            logger.info("applying migration %s", path.name)
            self._conn.executescript(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?)",

            self._conn.commit()
            applied.append(path.stem)

                quantity=ln["quantity"],
